Starting cards per the strategy: the Objective, a starting location that depends on the opponent (Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber or Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert) is marked '(SL)'), Tawss Khaa shown as the '(REP)', and Wise Advice, Your Insight Serves You Well plus Insurrection or Battle Plan. Posted 'Wise Advise' dested the Special Edition Effect Wise Advice (not the Reflections III shield); 'Heading For The Medical Fridgate' Heading For The Medical Frigate; 'Leia with Blaster Rifle' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Lando With Vibro Ax' Lando With Vibro-Ax; Ben Kenobi is the Special Edition character; Weapon Levitation is the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt; Alter is the Light Premiere interrupt; Yarna d'al' Gargan is the Jabba's Palace Effect (listed under Effects).
Unique cards posted at x2 (Tatooine, Alderaan, Ben Kenobi, Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight, Captain Han Solo, Leia With Blaster Rifle, Millennium Falcon) are kept as posted.
